rationale: The assistant correctly gave a clear stop-use, unplug and engineer-inspection message, directly answering the customer's safety question, and recommended no parts. It was repetitive (the stop-use and unplug instruction is said twice) and asked no follow-up about smoke, the lint filter or the vent hose, so it gave no safe power-off checks and no mention of 999 if smoke or fire appears. Its mention of lint build-up on the heater is hedged, so it is not an unsupported diagnosis, but the reply is generic and not tailored to the customer.
